in_marathi.name: Aritraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aritraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aritraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ari' meaning noble and 'traj' meaning charioteer. It is a name of great significance in Hindu mythology, particularly associated with the god Indra, who is often depicted as riding a chariot pulled by horses.
